# FG-AGENT-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`agent-supply-chain`](../../ops/runbooks/agent-supply-chain.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `revocation_update_without_an_allowed_author_is_not_silent` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: エージェントの設定の更新の MR を開けませんでした。プロジェクトの Developer 以上の人が、もう一度更新を頼んでください。
- en: The merge request that updates the agent configuration could not be opened. A Developer of the project should ask for the update again.
- id: Merge request yang memperbarui konfigurasi agen tidak dapat dibuka. Developer proyek sebaiknya meminta pembaruan lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A9 (ADR-0032 Amendment A9): the `agent.update_merge_request` job (`forge serve`) could not open the update merge request because nobody it may act for is allowed to. The merge request is always opened for a person, decided with that person's current rights (`AgentBuilderCompile`, a push of the branch, `MergeRequestCreate`): the person who asked (origin `update`) or, for a revocation, the first who may of the people who asked for the project's finished builds (newest first, at most 5). `reason`: `no_author` (the project has no finished build by a person), `author_not_allowed` (with `denied_code` of the first refusal and `candidates`: each left, was deactivated, lost the Developer role, or the branch `agent-builder/*` is protected against them), `closed_by_person` (the same update's merge request was closed — or merged — by a person: never reopened; also the `POST …/agent-builder/update` route's 409). Nothing was written. A revocation whose update is not opened leaves the revoked version in the project's lock: `forge/agent-lock` fails on it (FG-AGENT-0006) until someone updates.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The job's log line (`error_code`, `reason`, `project_id`, `author_id`, `origin`, `revoked`, `request_id` = the revocation's) and `SELECT id, state, last_error_code, payload FROM forge.jobs WHERE kind = 'agent.update_merge_request' ORDER BY id DESC` on the read pool. Runbook agent-supply-chain (the revoked part's projects).

## 対処 (fix)

A Developer of the project asks the update (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/agent-builder/update`, or the builder screen): it is opened for them. For `closed_by_person`, delete the branch `agent-builder/<digest>` first if the update is wanted after all.
